name: Indian Mush Cakes
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: sifted Indian meal
ingredients.originalText: a quart of sifted Indian meal

ingredients.name: wheat flour
ingredients.originalText: half a pint of wheat flour

instructions.text: Pour into a pan three pints of cold water, and stir gradually into it a quart of sifted Indian meal which has been mixed with half a pint of wheat flour, and a small tea-spoonful of salt.
Give it a hard stirring at the last.
Have ready a hot griddle, and bake the batter immediately, in cakes about the size of a saucer.
Send them to table piled evenly, but not cut.
Eat them with butter or molasses.

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Pour into a pan three pints of cold water, and stir gradually into it a quart of sifted Indian meal which has been mixed with half a pint of wheat flour, and a small tea-spoonful of salt.
2. Give it a hard stirring at the last.
3. Have ready a hot griddle, and bake the batter immediately, in cakes about the size of a saucer.
4. Send them to table piled evenly, but not cut.
5. Eat them with butter or molasses.
